title: Existential canonical representative square before strict-map selection
statement: For good flat-term K-flat integral complexes P,Q and their good total tensor, there exists a strict chain map ψ from ordinary reduction of the total tensor to the tensor of ordinary reductions such that the adjunction-normalized whole-system reduction tensor square commutes with the localization of ψ. Moreover, ψ has the finite component maps of the already assembled strict tensor reduction map, so uniqueness of strict assembly identifies ψ with that map.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 07A6; transport of the simultaneous representative normalization in step 2 of lem-coef-tensor-reduction-ordinary-model

proof.text: Transport the simultaneous representative normalization of the coefficient reduction calculus along the adjunction-normalized reduction and tensor model isomorphisms for P, Q and their total tensor. This produces a chain map ψ and the whole-system square.
Evaluate the transported representative square at each coefficient stage and use the normalized ordinary scalar tensor comparison; the finite components are exactly those of tensorReductionStrictMap.

theorem tensorReductionCanonicalSquare_exists (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory)
    (hT : integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W
      ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P.obj, Q.obj))) :
    let S := pullbackTensorCalculus l E W
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P.obj, Q.obj)
    let G := (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let B := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)).obj (G.obj P.obj, G.obj Q.obj)
    ∃ ψ : G.obj T ⟶ B,
      S.reduction.map ((S.integralTensorModel.iso (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) S.integralClosed
          P.obj Q.obj P.property.1 Q.property.1).hom) ≫
        S.reductionTensor.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
        S.systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app P)
            ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app Q)) =
      (pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app ⟨T, hT⟩ ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ψ ≫
        (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E W _ _
          (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W P)
          (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W Q)).hom ∧
      tensorReductionFiniteProperty l E W P.obj Q.obj ψ
